name: f4_pseudo2025
_doc: configs/f4_final.json on 2025 with month-out members (fs8 c7: prc-f8-c7a-mo). L1a-v2 loadings refitted without the held month on f4's own pre-daily rows (f4p1_pseudo2025_{mode}.parquet). In frozen mode the segment weights were fitted on these same four months (in-sample); crossfit mode refits them on the other three months.

prc-f-x5._note: x5 pinned to xgboost 2.1.4: prc-f-x5-mo/output/oof.csv holds all four folds (M1/M6 from that run, M2/M7 copied from prc-f-x5p-mo; identical values checked). The xgboost 3.4.1 runs were renamed prc-f-x5-xgb341 / prc-f-x5-mo-xgb341 and are not used.
